mainLayout.title: Masarah HR Recruitment | مسرة إتش أر للاستقدام
mainLayout.description: A licensed Saudi HR recruitment company bringing vetted domestic staff — housekeepers, drivers, home nurses, and cooks — and qualified commercial workers from abroad to households and companies across the Kingdom, with a formal, transparent process and follow-up that continues after arrival.
mainLayout.ogImageAlt: Masarah — licensed Saudi HR recruitment company for domestic and commercial staff

footer.title: Masarrah HR HR Recruitment
footer.about: Masarrah HR is a Saudi recruitment house bringing vetted domestic and commercial staff from abroad to households and companies across the Kingdom, with a clear, formal and trusted process.

newsletter.title: A clear note when the next step matters.
newsletter.body: Receive occasional guidance on recruitment routes, preparation and the details worth knowing before you request a service.
newsletter.success: You are on the list. We will be in touch with the next brief.

trust.headline: A trusted worker starts with a clear first step
trust.body: We review documents and licenses before the process begins, so you have a formal path from your first request to arrival.
trust.imageAlt: A team of workers arriving in the Kingdom through a formal recruitment journey

contracts.headline: Every clause understood. Every right protected.
contracts.body: We review the contract with you in plain language, so you know what you commit to and receive before signing.
contracts.imageAlt: Organized contract documents on a formal desk with a stamp and pen

support.headline: Our work does not end at the signature
support.body: The Masarrah HR team follows the trial period and helps with administrative issues, so both sides can settle with confidence.
support.imageAlt: A family and work team sharing a scene of arrival and settling in the Kingdom

goverments.title: Government-approved partners
goverments.body: Licensed and registered with the official authorities regulating recruitment in the Kingdom.

logos.ministryOfLabor: the Ministry of Labor and Development

platform.ariaLabel: How the Masarrah HR recruitment platform works
platform.title: A formal path from first request to settled support.
platform.body: Masarrah HR brings each recruitment step into one clear journey, so households and companies always know what happens next and who is responsible.
platform.promise: One request. One accountable team. A process you can follow.
platform.action: Speak with a Masarrah HR advisor

panel.label: The Masarrah HR route
panel.title: Your recruitment file, kept in view
panel.note: No public pricing or marketplace browsing. We start with your needs, then prepare a private recommendation.

request.label: Request
request.title: Start with the need, not a catalogue
request.body: Tell us about your home or business, the role you need, and the timing that works for you.

screening.label: Review
screening.title: Requirements become a clear brief
screening.body: Our team reviews the details with you and explains the next requirements before any commitment.

arrival.label: Arrival
arrival.title: A documented route to the Kingdom
arrival.body: We keep the recruitment path organized from selection and contracts through the worker’s arrival.

support.label: Support
support.title: Follow-up that continues after arrival
support.body: The relationship stays open for the practical questions that help both sides settle with confidence.

services.ariaLabel: Masarrah HR domestic worker rental services
services.title: Domestic workers on the terms that suit your home.
services.body: Choose the rental term that matches your routine — by the hour, day, week, or month — and tell us what you need. Every request is prepared privately around your household.
services.catalogueNote: Private requests, prepared around your home.

recruitment.title: Recruitment Request
recruitment.description: Full-time domestic workers placed in your home through our formal recruitment corridors, with a contract prepared around your household.
recruitment.imageAlt: Domestic worker hired into a household

transfer.title: Request to Transfer Services
transfer.description: Move an existing worker's services to your household through a documented transfer handled by our office.
transfer.imageAlt: Transferring a worker's services to a new household

rental.title: Rental Request
rental.description: Workers rented by the hour, day, week, or month — domestic support arranged around your home's own routine.
rental.imageAlt: Domestic worker rented by the hour, day, week or month

hourlyRental.title: Hourly Domestic Worker Rental
hourlyRental.description: Domestic support rented by the hour, arranged around the days, hours, and duties you need in your home.
hourlyRental.detail: A few hours a day, occasional visits, or a recurring hourly slot.

dailyRental.title: Daily Domestic Worker Rental
dailyRental.description: A domestic worker rented for a full day on the days you choose, matched to your household routine and working hours.
dailyRental.detail: Fixed days per week, full-day shifts, and the daily tasks that keep your home running.

weeklyRental.title: Weekly Domestic Worker Rental
weeklyRental.description: Domestic support rented on a weekly basis for households that need consistent help through the week.
weeklyRental.detail: A continuing weekly schedule with duties agreed in advance.

monthlyRental.title: Monthly Domestic Worker Rental
monthlyRental.description: A domestic worker rented by the month for steady, long-term support that fits the rhythm of your home.
monthlyRental.detail: A monthly arrangement with a clear schedule, duties, and ongoing follow-up.

globalWorkforce.title: Domestic Workers from Around the World
globalWorkforce.description: Domestic workforce available from a wide range of countries, matched to the role and preferences of your home.
globalWorkforce.detail: Nationalities and profiles drawn from our recruitment corridors.

countries.title: Trusted routes into the Kingdom.
countries.body: We work across established recruitment corridors, bringing each request into a clear, private process built around the role and the household or business behind it.
